summary: Checking documents with anti-plagiarism services, interpreting originality reports, and the rules of copyright protection.

blocks.content: Presenting **someone else's words, ideas, code or images as your own**, without proper acknowledgement.

blocks.title: Forms of plagiarism
rows: Copying paragraphs from a website without quotation marks or a reference
Changing some words but keeping the author's ideas and structure
Submitting your own earlier work again as new
Copying program code from a classmate or the Internet
Submitting text written by an AI tool as your own work, when not allowed

blocks.content: Services such as **Antiplagiat**, **Turnitin**, **Unicheck**, **Grammarly plagiarism checker** and free online checkers compare a document with large databases of web pages, publications and previously submitted work.

blocks.title: Checking a document
items: Upload the file or paste the text into the service.
The service splits the text into fragments and searches its databases for matches.
It produces an **originality (similarity) report**: the percentage of matching text and the **sources** found, with matches highlighted.
Review each match: properly **quoted and referenced** text is acceptable; unreferenced matches must be rewritten in your own words or cited.

blocks.content: A similarity percentage is **not a verdict** — quotations with references, common phrases and the reference list also match. The teacher looks at **what** matches, not only the number.
Avoid plagiarism: take notes in your own words, put direct quotes in quotation marks, **cite every source** (author, title, year, URL, date accessed) and keep a reference list.

blocks.title: Main rules
rows: A work is protected from the moment it is created; registration is not required
Only the copyright holder may copy, distribute, adapt, perform or sell the work, or give permission
Rights last for a long time — in Kazakhstan, during the author's life plus **70 years**
Others may use a work only under the terms of a licence (EULA, Creative Commons, GPL)
The author's right to be named and to protect the work from distortion
Limited quotation for study, criticism, news — **with the source cited**
Programs are protected like literary works; installing a copy on more computers than the licence allows is illegal

blocks.title: Creative Commons licence elements
rows: Share alike — derivatives under the same licence
